requirements.threshold: Delegation requires independently useful output and expected context reduction, parallelism, or review value greater than coordination cost; repository breadth alone is insufficient.
requirements.text: Apply the value gate before proactive delegation.

requirements.threshold: Short deterministic and local tasks plus direct user clarification stay in the main session unless the value gate passes.
requirements.text: Preserve deterministic execution, integration, commit, and reporting ownership in the main session.

requirements.threshold: Authorization, high-risk judgment, secrets, external writes, and destructive changes are never delegated unless an explicit separate policy allows it.
Every final report states whether helpers were used; when used it includes role, write scope, and the main-session acceptance path.
Delegated work has explicit write scope and read-only context assumptions.
A writable candidate establishes one independently reviewable and validatable invariant with an explicit later integration gate.
requirements.text: Use an admissible implementation slice rather than a broad active plan as the candidate boundary.

requirements.threshold: Separate risk and ambiguity select Spark low/low, Terra for ordinary without high, and refusal for either high; writable Sol is refused.
requirements.text: Route writable implementation by strict declared inputs.

scenarios.task: Change one shared invariant across many tightly coupled files.
scenarios.source: The repository-wide path count is large, but helper outputs require repeated reconciliation and are not independently useful.

scenarios.task: Review repository-wide security hardening while retaining sensitive decisions in the parent.
scenarios.source: Read-only findings are independently useful; secrets, authorization, and final acceptance remain excluded.
